policy: Only direct official Pearl Abyss facts may enter confirmedFacts. Unpublished routes, weaknesses, phases, statistics, rewards and rematch locations remain unresolved.

rematchRules.label: Activation
rematchRules.value: A boss Memory Fragment becomes active after that boss is defeated.

rematchRules.label: Access
rematchRules.value: Documented rematches begin from the relevant Memory Fragment at the previous encounter site.

rematchRules.label: Modes
rematchRules.value: Reminisce preserves the original boss state; Resonate scales the boss when player progression is higher.

rematchRules.label: Resources
rematchRules.value: Consumables are restored after a rematch and separate rematch loot is not awarded under the documented system.

rematchRules.label: Discovery
rematchRules.value: Known Memory Fragment locations can be reviewed through Journal > Knowledge > Memory Fragments > Bosses.
